redFirst.basis: Regression task with expectRedFirst false. The task adds a fixture and the test that pins it, and both are new (untracked) files, so HEAD has no prior behaviour to show red. On HEAD the test file would fail at import because the fixture files do not exist, which is a load error, not an assertion failure.

outcome.technical: Reviewed the existing fictional Northwind Freight fixture (tests/fixtures/golden/architecture.model.json, issues.json) and tests/golden.test.mjs against the brief's richness requirements and its tests.add entry. Every requirement was already met, so the fixture was not changed. Coverage: 9 zones covering all 7 schema zone kinds (two marked outside, one nested via parent). 34 nodes at C4 levels 1, 2 and 3. 51 edges using all 12 schema edge types, including 7 async edges (queue and event), all 3 confidence values, and foundBy static or llm. 12 entities (table, view, collection), with fields carrying declared, observed and inferred provenance. 14 relations: fk/declared, name-convention/inferred and join/observed. 20 CRUD access rows. 7 sequences using all three step shapes (message, fragment, note) and every fragment kind (alt, else, opt, loop, end). 6 views. meta.repoUrl is https://example.invalid/northwind-freight, meta.commit is a fixed fake 40-hex sha, and evidence uses generic backend/, frontend/, infra/ and deploy/ paths. issues.json holds 6 synthetic issues, one each for security, data, reliability, performance, design and docs. They anchor to an edge, an entity, a step and nodes, each states class, consequence and fix, and every detail is empty. One real gap was fixed, a wording change in tests/golden.test.mjs only: the header comment now calls the fixture a hand-written model of a fictional app, the g6 title says 'meta is fictional', and the g7 title and skip message no longer describe the check as anonymisation. Case ids and assertions are unchanged. Runs: `node --test tests/golden.test.mjs` exited 0 with 7/7 pass. Full `node --test` exited 0 with 42 tests, 42 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, including all seven golden cases g1-g7. To check the visible skip, I copied the test, fixtures, scripts and schema to a scratch tree with no .private/ and ran `node --test tests/golden.test.mjs` there: 6 pass, 1 skipped, and g7 printed its skip reason. Denylist grep, case-insensitive with 14 terms, over the three P1.3 files (both fixture JSONs and the test): 0 matching lines in each file. Dependants: schema/archmap-model.schema.json, schema/archmap-issues.schema.json and scripts/validate.mjs are still correct, because the fixture validates with zero findings (g1). README.md is still correct because it names only the generic docs/architecture/architecture.model.json path. docs/design.md is outside P1.3's files and was not edited, but its step-1 line (line 172) still describes the golden fixture with the old wording rather than as a fictional, hand-written model. The orchestrator may want a follow-up there.
outcome.descriptive: The fictional Northwind Freight golden fixture validates and meets every richness requirement. The test wording now calls it fictional, and the full suite passes (42/42).
